title: MSFS Marketplace Update (Feb 7) – HUGE Week for new Airports! LIM6, VVTS, KBZN & more
description:
The February 7th Marketplace Update brings a fresh batch of highly requested airports to Microsoft Flight Simulator 2020. This week’s must‑have pick is the beautifully detailed VVTS Tan Son Nhat International Airport V2 by DOMINICDESIGNTEAM.

✈️ New airports added this week (PC)
The following airports were newly released in the marketplace this week:

🛫 Voyager Sim Project: LIM6 Salina Fly Airfield (Small Italian airfield perfect for GA flyers)
🛫 DOMINICDESIGNTEAM: VVTS Tan Son Nhat Intl Airport V2 (Major Vietnamese hub in stunning detail)
🛫 Taimodels: KBZN Bozeman Yellowstone Airport (Popular gateway to Yellowstone National Park)
🛫 Impulse Simulations: YPLC Port Lincoln Airport (Beautiful Australian regional airport)

🌆 New sceneries added this week (PC)
The following sceneries were newly released in the marketplace this week:

🌆 Dreamscenery: Edinburgh Region Enhanced Road Lights (Improved night lighting for the region)
🌆 Dreamscenery: Frankfort Region Enhanced Road Lights (Enhanced illumination for nighttime VFR)
🌆 Dreamscenery: Harrisburg Region Enhanced Road Lights (Brighter and more realistic road lighting)
🌆 Dreamscenery: Helena Region Enhanced Road Lights (Improved regional night visuals)

If you enjoy these Marketplace Update breakdowns, don’t forget to hit like, subscribe, and drop a comment telling me which airport you’re picking up this week!

✈️ See you in the skies!
